exposure: Isolated single umbilical artery group vs. control group
outcome: Cesarean delivery due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate
cohort: Singleton pregnancies delivered between May 2006 and May 2013, with 93 cases of isolated single umbilical artery and 100 randomly selected controls without abnormalities
finding: The incidence of SGA fetuses and hypertensive disorders in pregnancy was significantly higher in the isolated single umbilical artery group, while preterm birth and cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal heart rate were not significantly different.
